caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded, ceramic jug placed against a plain, light-beige background. The jug has a reddish-brown body with a smooth, matte finish, and features a short, narrow neck with a slightly flared rim. A single, curved handle is attached from the neck to the shoulder of the jug. The surface of the jug is decorated with two large, irregular patches of light yellow glaze, which drip downwards in elongated streams. The handle and some areas of the body also have a slight bluish-grey tint. There is no other object or decoration in the image, and the name "WILLIAM SPIEKER" is faintly visible near the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Galena Pottery Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
